title: Harness Lab
blurb: Curated tips and methods that make this Field Brief / EM fleet stronger — Grok bots, Mac CLIs, vault, routines, and launch standards. Keep only what we can apply; not generic AI news.

entries.title: launchd StartCalendarInterval — wake catch-up, but power-off still skips
entries.why: Apple: a launchd job scheduled with StartCalendarInterval runs when the Mac wakes if it slept through the slot (missed slots coalesce into one run), but is skipped if the Mac was off; cron and other launchd jobs simply skip. Mac-side routines should be StartCalendarInterval agents that are idempotent per date, with the box-side missed-runs ledger as the net for power-off/offline days (the 2026-09-25 gap). appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: codex exec — --json + --output-last-message proof, exec resume --last, login status probe
entries.why: Codex CLI reference: pair --json with --output-last-message for unattended runs (event stream + final-summary file), continue with codex exec resume --last (cwd-scoped; --all across dirs) instead of relaunching, and codex login status exits 0 when credentials are present. Gives Astra seats a file proof artifact for vault notes, a watchdog resume path, and an exit-code auth probe for the usage dashboard. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: claude -p drops quiet subagents at 10 min; SIGTERM leaves the turn unfinished
entries.why: Claude Code headless docs: -p waits for background subagents but drops partial results after 10 minutes of idle waiting (CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS), and SIGTERM exits 143 with no result for the in-progress turn while SIGINT ends it cleanly. grok-tmux-watchdog flags stale at 540s, just under that ceiling — treat the 540–600s window explicitly and send SIGINT before any relaunch/resume. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: workmux resurrect — crash-recovery resume for agent worktrees
entries.why: Restores tmux/worktree agent sessions after crash from persisted state with agent-specific resume args (Codex resume, etc.). Candidate pattern for Mac CLI relaunch-vs-resume before grok-tmux-run; dry-run first. Lab backlog/smoke — do not replace fleet watchdog. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: Usage honesty — session /status ≠ plan /usage ≠ API spend
entries.why: Codex subagents add model/tool cost beyond a single seat; CLI surfaces differ: session context (/status), plan quota (/usage), and Platform API org spend are not the same meter. For Tongli usage dashboard: keep PROXY labels when estimating routine fires; prefer live CLI quota bars when a seat exposes them; never invent dollar costs. Correct-step KEEP after Muse false-friend Vault noise. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: Three-Run Proof — Observe → Correct → Release before Lab automation
entries.why: OpenAI harness engineering treats agent work as incomplete until checkable proof (review loops, live artifacts). For Harness Lab: require three independent scout seats (Observe bugs surfaced, Correct fixes pipeline, Release clean E2E) and live Pages verify before enabling daily collect/curate routines. Lab process KEEP; appliedToPlaybook false until harness playbook page exists.

entries.title: session-bandit — redacted Markdown handoff from local transcripts
entries.why: Indexes Claude Code / Codex local JSONL offline (no API) and export-md writes a redacted, provenance-linked Markdown artifact plus redaction report. Candidate machine-checkable half for box↔Mac EM continuation and vault handoff notes; inspect before filing; backlog/smoke. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: pi-tmux-agents — awaiting_review parent gate before accept
entries.why: Settled child enters awaiting_review; parent must inspect result/workspace then accept|revise|take_over|dismiss|escalate (human only on escalate). Portable CoS pattern for Mac CLI tmux subagents and complements evidence≠instruction. Lab card/backlog — no fleet replace of grok-tmux-watchdog. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: orch — full harness panes on tmux with heartbeats
entries.why: Spawns independent Claude/Codex/Pi/Gemini harnesses in tmux panes (full seats, not shared-turn subagents) with heartbeats and addressable prompts. Closest public substrate idea for future grok-tmux-run lanes; Lab backlog only — do not install as fleet replace. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: hat-tmux workbench — status-line watchdog + single quota writer
entries.why: Public workbench turns tmux status-line redraw into a launchd tracker-server watchdog (≤30s self-heal) and enforces a single writer for the quota cache so handoff state and limit resets stay truthful. Pattern idea for Mac CoS/EM panes before grok-tmux-run; backlog/smoke only. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: Harness sensors — LLM-optimized feedback before human review
entries.why: Martin Fowler: outer harness raises first-pass correctness and adds sensors whose signals are optimized for LLM self-correction before human eyes. Maps to CoS evidence≠instruction, usage miss-watch, and Three-Run Proof as a named sensor on Lab automation. Process KEEP; appliedToPlaybook false until harness playbook page exists.

entries.title: Claude gateway — BASE_URL alone under-counts usage
entries.why: Claude Code docs: setting only ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL still uses the saved claude.ai subscription credential, so a usage proxy can silently under-count. Honest fleet metering needs a gateway credential (gateway /login or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN for a self-hosted gateway) when routing through a proxy. Lab KEEP for usage-dashboard honesty; no secrets published. appliedToPlaybook false.
